evidence.reason: The current test already implements the suggested fix. At the tested positive case it sets `const measuredSha = ctx.mqTip;` and passes that value into `propose(ctx, { coverage: 95.04 }, measuredSha)`, with a comment noting the measurement must be of the main tip because the proposer refuses a SHA that is not the origin/main tip. This directly replaces the alleged `git(ctx.repo, ['rev-parse', 'HEAD'])` usage, so the stale-guard failure described no longer applies. Commit d8337983817f8c2cf73acb5e522d5ef63f805075 ("fix(test): measure the main tip in ratchet-propose proposal cases") is the fixing commit in the supplied history.
